_note: Anchors measured by hand from the plate, not detected. Gemini's spatial localisation was tried first and was not accurate enough on figures this small: the boxes came back offset and about twice the true height. Vision is used for what it is good at - relative and magnitude judgements about shadows, counts and colour - and geometry is measured once, by a person, per plate.

ground._note: Foreshortening of the sand plane: how much one unit of depth away from camera compresses vertically compared with one unit across frame. Measured from the beach perspective in this plate.
